limitations: True PLAY screenshots with controlled first-player camera sweeps, fixed simulation timestep and bounded duration; no full-match, natural-input, long-session, FPS or input-latency acceptance.
PT without RR uses a snapshot-only in-memory Environment override; the normal UI intentionally gates that combination.
DDGI and PT were separate actual runs; D3D12 path tracing is unavailable in this fork and these material matrices are Vulkan only.
No active DLSS AI model identity, inserted-frame presentation, FG 2X, Reflex latency, MFG or Dynamic MFG claim is made by these material matrices.
Cold asynchronous hit-group compilation may show grey placeholders; synchronous controls do not establish a clean cold asynchronous path.

Standard vertex-colour routing covers a conservative opaque nonemissive subset. Alpha clipping/blending, transparency, refraction, emission, position/matrix overrides, trails, point size and heightmap/parallax stay excluded.
Expanded MultiMesh instances increase TLAS/resource work; no performance-regression conclusion is available.
Screen-space derivatives were replaced only in the two named game shaders with a first-order local pixel-footprint approximation, not general ray differentials or a texture-LOD rewrite.
Strict GPU validation remains non-clean: lifecycle PRESENT_AFTER_WRITE and historical Streamline Vulkan 09600/03868/FG diagnostics remain separate; original failures are preserved.
Original C1, BCC front-end shader failure, owner red and colour red evidence are not overwritten by later independent passes.
